title: Cart Isolation
statement: Implement `solve(adds)`. `adds` is a list of `[cart, item]` pairs. `cart` is `a` or `b`. Create two carts that do not share an items list. Apply the adds. Return `{"a": [...], "b": [...]}` with each cart's items in order.
constraints: Appending to one must not change the other
hints: Construct two objects. Give each its own list inside __init__.
Do not use a class-level list.
Return copies of the two lists.

approaches.name: Direct
approaches.explanation: A class attribute list is shared by every instance.

editorial: A class attribute list is shared by every instance. The bug shows up as soon as the second cart is created and sees the first cart's items. Creating the list in __init__ gives each instance its own object. The result dict is the two independent histories.
